style: chunky pixel-art style, hard pixel edges, no anti-aliasing, no glow, no text, no grid lines, no cell borders, no shadows, transparent background

cat.name: 猫咪
stages: stage 1, a tiny round baby kitten with a big head and tiny body, plain with no accessories
stage 2, a young cat, taller and slightly slimmer, wearing a red collar with a golden bell
stage 3, a majestic adult cat, larger with a fluffy chest and a long raised striped tail, wearing the red collar with a golden bell and a small golden crown

fox.name: 狐狸
fox.identity: cute red fox with a white muzzle, white chest and a white-tipped bushy tail
stages: stage 1, a tiny round baby fox cub with a big head and tiny body, plain with no accessories
stage 2, a young fox, taller and slightly slimmer with an upright bushy tail, wearing a green neck scarf
stage 3, a majestic adult fox, larger with a fluffy chest and a long raised bushy tail, wearing the green neck scarf and a small leaf crown

rabbit.name: 兔子
rabbit.identity: cute white rabbit with long ears, pink inner ears and a fluffy round tail
stages: stage 1, a tiny round baby bunny with a big head and short ears, plain with no accessories
stage 2, a young rabbit with longer upright ears, wearing a small blue bow tie
stage 3, a majestic adult rabbit with very long ears and a fluffy chest, wearing the blue bow tie and a silver star-shaped brooch

penguin.name: 企鹅
penguin.identity: cute chubby penguin with a white belly, black back and tiny orange beak and feet
stages: stage 1, a tiny round baby penguin chick with a big head and fluffy grey down, plain with no accessories
stage 2, a young penguin, taller and smoother, wearing a pair of red earmuffs
stage 3, a majestic adult penguin, larger with a glossy black back, wearing the red earmuffs and a small golden medal around its neck

panda.name: 熊猫
panda.identity: cute chubby panda with black ears, black eye patches, a white face and belly
stages: stage 1, a tiny round baby panda cub with a big head, plain with no accessories
stage 2, a young panda, taller and slightly slimmer, with a small green bamboo leaf tuft on top of its head
stage 3, a majestic adult panda, larger and fluffier, with three green bamboo leaves on top of its head

corgi.name: 柯基犬
corgi.identity: cute corgi puppy with a golden and white coat, short stubby legs and big upright ears
stages: stage 1, a tiny round corgi puppy with a big head and stubby legs, plain with no accessories
stage 2, a young corgi, taller with a longer body, wearing a red bandana around its neck
stage 3, a majestic adult corgi, larger and fluffier, wearing the red bandana and a golden bone-shaped pendant

hamster.name: 仓鼠
hamster.identity: cute round golden hamster with tiny ears, a cream belly and a pink nose
stages: stage 1, a tiny round baby hamster with a big head and tiny paws, plain with no accessories
stage 2, a young hamster, slightly taller, with a sunflower seed stuffed in one cheek
stage 3, a majestic adult hamster, larger and rounder, keeping the sunflower seed in its cheek and a small sunflower on top of its head

parrot.name: 鹦鹉
parrot.identity: cute chubby parrot with a green body, red crest feathers and a yellow beak
stages: stage 1, a tiny round baby parrot chick with fluffy grey down and a big head
stage 2, a young parrot with green feathers growing in and a single short red crest feather on its head
stage 3, a majestic adult parrot with a full red crest, a green body and long blue tail feathers

hedgehog.name: 刺猬
hedgehog.identity: cute hedgehog with soft brown spikes, a cream face and belly, and tiny paws
stages: stage 1, a tiny round baby hedgehog with short soft spikes and a big head
stage 2, a young hedgehog, slightly larger, with a red apple on its back
stage 3, a majestic adult hedgehog, larger with longer spikes, carrying the red apple and a small brown mushroom on its back

deer.name: 鹿
deer.identity: cute fawn-colored deer with a cream belly, a small pink nose and white spots on its back
stages: stage 1, a tiny round baby deer with a big head, tiny legs and no antlers
stage 2, a young deer with small budding antlers
stage 3, a majestic adult deer with large branch-like antlers and a small blue flower tucked behind one ear

lion.name: 狮子
lion.identity: cute golden lion cub with a cream belly, a round face and a tufted tail
stages: stage 1, a tiny round lion cub with a big head and tiny body, plain with no mane
stage 2, a young lion with a modest golden-brown mane starting to grow
stage 3, a majestic adult lion with a large fluffy mane and a small scarlet cape on its shoulders

pig.name: 小猪
pig.identity: cute chubby pink piglet with a curly tail, a round snout and pink cheeks
stages: stage 1, a tiny round baby piglet with a big head and tiny legs, plain with no accessories
stage 2, a young pig, slightly taller, wearing a small pink flower crown
stage 3, a majestic adult pig, larger and rounder, wearing a fuller pink flower crown and a pink ribbon on its curly tail

owl.name: 猫头鹰
owl.identity: cute round brown owl with a cream belly, big round yellow eyes and tiny wings
stages: stage 1, a tiny round baby owl with a big head and fluffy down, plain with no accessories
stage 2, a young owl, slightly taller, wearing small round eyeglasses
stage 3, a majestic adult owl, larger with defined feathers, wearing the round eyeglasses and a small graduation cap

dragon.name: 小龙
dragon.identity: cute chubby baby dragon with mint-teal scales, a cream belly, tiny wings and small amber horns
stages: stage 1, a tiny round baby dragon with a big head and tiny wings, plain with no accessories
stage 2, a young dragon with slightly larger wings and small amber horns
stage 3, a majestic adult dragon with large wings, long amber horns and a glowing golden pearl on its forehead

unicorn.name: 独角兽
unicorn.identity: cute chubby white unicorn with a golden horn, a pastel pink mane and a fluffy tail
stages: stage 1, a tiny round baby unicorn foal with a big head and a tiny golden horn bud
stage 2, a young unicorn with a small golden horn and a short pink mane
stage 3, a majestic adult unicorn with a long golden horn, a flowing rainbow mane and a fluffy white tail
